content:
elaine: Heads up — noticed CI service account got an extra IAM binding on prod yesterday, looks like terraform drift. possible secret read from vault-mount. :eyes:
ops-bot: [alert] anomaly_detected: iam_policy_change on serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com at 2025-11-12T22:14:03Z
samir: can you paste the audit lines?
elaine: here's the relevant stackdriver snippet: "protoPayload.methodName":"SetIamPolicy","resourceName":"projects/redwood-prod/serviceAccounts/ci-runner" then later "protoPayload.authorizationInfo.permission":"secretmanager.versions.access"
leo: wow, so CI SA may have gained Secret Manager access. any idea how this happened? terraform apply?
elaine: looks like a manual `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding` in a jumpbox session, user: infra-shadow@redwood.com. likely someone ran a quick fix and didnt update tf.
marta: immediate mitigation: revoke the binding and rotate any tokens that used that SA. who owns the CI pipeline?
samir: I can revoke the binding now. running: ```bash
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \  --member=serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \  --role=roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor```
ops-bot: action_executed: remove-iam-policy-binding by samir at 2025-11-12T22:20:18Z
samir: done. binding removed. next: rotate KMS key(s) used by vault transit. we should also revoke Vault token(s) that were minted to the CI job.
elaine: Vault path affected is `secret/data/prod/*` mounted via GCP KMS key `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/vault-transit`. We need an emergency rewrap + key rotation plan.
leo: quick command to revoke active Vault tokens: `vault token revoke -prefix ci-` (run from vault-admin host). I can run that if ops ok.
marta: also run an audit query to enumerate what secrets were accessed by that SA in last 72h. stackdriver query: ```json
resource.type="audited_resource"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="service-account-ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
protoPayload.methodName:"AccessSecretVersion"
```
security-oncall: FYI creating an incident ticket INC-2025-3212 for this, severity P2 until we confirm exposure. adding legal/compliance for potential data access.
samir: rekeying plan: 1) create new key version in KMS 2) add to vault-transit key ring 3) rewrap secrets with `vault rewrap` 4) revoke old key version only after rewrap verification. timeline estimate 90m.
elaine: owners: samir (IAM revoke + KMS key create), leo (vault token revocation + rewrap), marta (audit + compliance comms).
ops-bot: scheduled_checkin: please post status updates in this thread every 30m.
leo: started revoking ci tokens, running `vault token revoke -prefix ci-` now.
samir: created new KMS key version v2 and tested encrypt/decrypt with a test secret. pushing rewrap job to batch.
marta: audit query shows 3 AccessSecretVersion entries at 2025-11-12T21:59:41Z and 2025-11-12T22:03:09Z by that SA — likely read of `prod/db_password` and `prod/stripe_key`.
elaine: stripe key rotation plan: rotate creds in Stripe, update services to use new key, revoke old key in Stripe UI. I've looped in payments eng.
security-oncall: added compliance note: document timeline, list of keys/secrets accessed, and mitigation steps. legal to review.
leo: rewrap finished for 87 secrets. verifying integrity and running smoke tests.
samir: after rewrap, I disabled older KMS key version and scheduled it for destruction in 7 days.
marta: closing checklist: confirm no leftover IAM bindings, rotated external creds (Stripe), rotated DB passwords, reissued CI SA keys with least privilege and tf corrected.
elaine: agreed. follow-up retro required to prevent manual fixes. propose a pre-merge policy check to block direct `gcloud` in jumpbox sessions.
ops-bot: incident INC-2025-3212 updated: status=mitigated by team at 2025-11-12T23:49:15Z :thumbsup:
